WITH per_source AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, '[missing]') AS funding_source,
         AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS size
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '[missing]')
), sized AS (
  SELECT funding_source, avg_ratio, size,
         AVG(size) OVER () AS avg_size
  FROM per_source
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(size) AS combined_size,
       AVG(size - avg_size) AS avg_excess_size
FROM sized
WHERE size > avg_size;
